headline: &TEAM and SANTOS BRAVOS release collab single 'ORIGAMI'
sub: HYBE's Latin boy band reunites with &TEAM for a 2nd collaboration
source: Source: HYBE LABELS, via Korean media
caption:
&TEAM and SANTOS BRAVOS have teamed up again with new single 'ORIGAMI'.

The track is the second collaboration between HYBE's Latin boy band SANTOS BRAVOS and &TEAM, released Nov 20 at midnight local time after two MV teasers.
